# Threads

Threads is Meta's social network for publishing posts, managing replies, discovering public content, and analyzing profile and post performance.

Category: Communication. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/threads/.

## Actions

- **Create and Share Post**: Create and publish a top-level Threads post and cross-share it to the linked Instagram account as a Story.
- **Create Post**: Create and publish a top-level Threads text, image, video, carousel, quote, poll, ghost, GIF, or text-attachment post, optionally with a…
- **Create Reply**: Create and publish a reply to a Threads post, including a text, image, video, carousel, quote, poll, GIF, or text-attachment reply.
- **Delete Post**: Permanently delete a Threads post owned by the connected profile.
- **Get Location** (read-only): Retrieve one Threads location by ID for inspection or post tagging.
- **Get My Profile** (read-only): Return the connected or app-scoped Threads user's profile and identity fields.
- **Get Post** (read-only): Retrieve one Threads post by ID.
- **Get Post Embed** (read-only): Return embeddable HTML and oEmbed metadata for a public Threads post.
- **Get Post Insights** (read-only): Return selected lifetime engagement metrics for one post owned by the connected Threads profile.
- **Get Profile Insights** (read-only): Return one time-window page of selected profile time-series, totals, link clicks, follower counts, or follower demographics for a Threads…
- **Get Publishing Limits** (read-only): Return current usage and configured quota for Threads posts, replies, deletes, location searches, or all publishing categories.
- **List Ghost Posts** (read-only): List active and archived ghost posts created by the connected Threads profile, one cursor page at a time.
- **List My Mentions** (read-only): List public Threads posts that mention the connected profile, one cursor page at a time.
- **List My Posts** (read-only): List posts created by the connected Threads profile, one cursor page at a time.
- **List My Replies** (read-only): List replies created by the connected Threads profile, one cursor page at a time.
- **List Pending Replies** (read-only): List one page of pending or ignored replies for an owned Threads post.
- **List Post Replies** (read-only): Return either immediate replies or the flattened full conversation for a Threads post, one cursor page at a time.
- **List Public Profile Posts** (read-only): List one cursor page of posts from a qualifying public Threads profile by exact username.
- **Lookup Public Profile** (read-only): Look up a qualifying public Threads profile by exact username.
- **Repost Post**: Repost an existing Threads post to the connected profile.
- **Review Pending Reply**: Approve or ignore one pending reply.
- **Search Locations** (read-only): Search Threads locations by text, coordinates, or both.
- **Search Posts** (read-only): Search one page of Threads posts by keyword or topic tag.
- **Set Reply Visibility**: Hide or unhide a top-level reply and its nested replies on a post managed by the connected profile.
